size.description: optional static integer specifying the number of nonzero entries to return. If there are more nonzero elements than the specified ``size``, then indices will be truncated at the end. If there are fewer nonzero elements than the specified size, then indices will be padded with ``fill_value``, which defaults to zero.
constraints: size must be statically specified for use within JAX transformations

fill_value.description: optional padding value when ``size`` is specified. Defaults to 0.

output.description: Tuple of JAX Arrays of length ``a.ndim``, containing the indices of each nonzero value.
